pages.title: Your Discoveries
pages.text: The collection records identified gear, its best rarity and tier, and how often you identified it. Boss prizes are tracked too.$(br2)Unknown gear stays a silhouette until discovered. Native variants sharing an item ID share an entry.

pages.title: Open Your Collection
pages.text: $(c:/tnkloot collection)$(bold)Open discovery collection$(/c)$()$(br2)Browse your two-page collection book by equipment group, discovered, undiscovered or boss rewards.$(br2)Use its Back to journal button to return here. You can also open it with $(bold)/tnkloot collection$().
